verdict.rationale: Gumloop's first-party trigger docs say agents can be scheduled to run automatically on a recurring schedule, distinct from one-time triggers. The welcome page also positions schedules as a core automation path. Missing for 10: documented detail on schedule configuration (frequency/cron options, time zones, failure/retry handling), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Schedule your agent to run automatically on a recurring schedule or as a one-time trigger.
Set up scheduled triggers to run on a recurring or one-time basis
then automate them with triggers, schedules, and the API.
